comments.author: @LMDiscoveryGlobe
comments.text: The contrast is heartbreaking: spending billions on empty mega-cities and golden monuments while the actual citizens have to line up for subsidized bread.

replies.author: @AmazingGlobalDiscoveries
replies.text: You’re absolutely right—the contrast is one of the most striking and troubling parts of the story. Grand monuments and impressive architecture can look spectacular, but they feel very different when ordinary people are struggling with basic necessities.

My car gets slightly dusty after a 10-minute drive, and here they are legally requiring all cars to be spotless white. I would not survive 24 hours in Ashgabat. 😂

replies.author: @AmazingGlobalDiscoveries

comments.text: Standing in line for hours just to buy bread while living on top of world-class gas reserves is just heartbreaking.

replies.author: @AmazingGlobalDiscoveries
